desc2.cn: 当前种植区内有田块<@toast.key>待收获</>时将<@toast.key>自动进行收获并存入本设备中</>，如果设备仓储已满则无法自动收获
desc2.en: If a plot in the Eco-Farm enters the <@toast.key>awaiting harvest</> state, it will be <@toast.key>auto-harvested and the harvest stored in the facility storage</>. Auto-Harvest cannot be performed if the facility storage is full.

desc2.cn: 当前种植区内有田块<@toast.key>待育苗</>时将<@toast.key>自动进行育苗</>
desc2.en: If a plot in the Eco-Farm enters the <@toast.key>needs germinating</> state, it will be <@toast.key>auto-germinated</>.

desc2.cn: <@toast.key>青菜</>、<@toast.key>多味菇</>与<@toast.key>青叶莓</>田块在生长期时处于<@toast.key>“息壤环境”</>内可进行<@toast.key>优质化培育</>，<@toast.key>优质化培育</>完成后将成为<@toast.key>新物种</>
desc2.en: <@toast.key>Cabbage</>, <@toast.key>Relishroom</>, and <@toast.key>Sourberry</> plots in the growing phase can be placed in a <@toast.key>Xiranite environment</> to undergo <@toast.key>Refined Farming</>. Completing <@toast.key>Refined Farming</> converts the crop into <@toast.key>new variants</>.

desc2.cn: 已优质化的田块，与同种田块无缝相接可以<@toast.key>增加产量</>
desc2.en: A refined plot can <@toast.key>boost the yield</> of another plot of the same crop touching it.
